name: Starhound: War On The Frontier
source:
Take command of the Starhound, an advanced destroyer in a high-stakes interstellar conflict. Discover planets, encounter starships and face the unknown.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4367200/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在一場成敗攸關的星際衝突中，接掌先進驅逐艦「星際獵犬號」。發現行星，遭遇星艦，直面未知。

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4367200/]Steam[/url]］
